changelog:
Initial release of the SONA autonomous Solana wallet skill.

- Adds an agent that observes, reasons, and executes wallet actions within hardcoded constitutional laws (no override possible).
- Supports core wallet functions: SOL transfers, policy enforcement, assisted/god/standard modes, approvals, on-chain memos, and stateful chat commands.
- Includes 10 plugin tools for wallet queries, transfers, approvals, policy/status checks, and live price retrieval.
- Enforces spend limits (50M lamports/action) and policy overrides for all state-changing operations.
- Setup requires local agent start, session token generation, and environment variable configuration.
- All state-changing tools require authentication; read-only tools work without.
summary: Autonomous Solana wallet agent — AI reasons, Rust signs. Transfers, swaps, staking, chat, and mode switching under constitutional spend limits.
